title: 第5章 救场，露背戏-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    她自嘲地笑了笑。

    干脆掏出古董手机玩贪吃蛇，消磨时间。

    反正一时半会儿于导也忙不完，没空找她。

    然而，她还没玩几分钟，拍摄现场传来了争执声。

    “田馨！你搞什么飞机！这时候跟我说拍不了？！你是拿整个剧组开玩笑吗？”五十多岁的导演于清气的用手里的剧本用力砸了一下一旁的门框。

    引起了所有人的瞩目。

    韩小汐也好奇地探了探脑袋。

    一旁穿着纱衣戏服裹着羽绒服外套的田馨用纸巾擦着眼泪，“于导，我真的拍不了，我已经感冒了，水再热，这一遍遍的拍下来，我也吃不消。”

    她哭得梨花带雨，“您就用替身吧。”

    “田大小姐！是你自己先前说今天的戏不需要替身的，说你自己上！临到要拍了，你耍我呢！你知道停一分钟耽误多少钱吗？！”于清气得就差飙脏话。

    有人过来劝架，但田馨就是一副“我有后台，你又换不掉我”的表情。

    油盐不进。

    韩小汐注意到，男主沈珩已经跑到休息椅上喝水去了，压根没管争吵的双方。

    穿着的还是之前她看到的黑色长款羽绒服。

    戴着头套，古装造型，面上肤色故意调暗了，看上去更加棱角分明。

    似是注意到有人看自己，沈珩侧过了头，看到韩小汐，微怔了一下，随即冲她微微点了下头。

    韩小汐很没出息的咧嘴傻笑。

    正在这时，刘超火急火燎的冲她跑了过来。

    “小汐小汐！快点救个场！”说着直接拉着她往冲突中心带。

    韩小汐还没反应过来就被拽走了，沈珩看在眼里放下水杯，蹙了蹙眉。

    “于导，现场有替身！”刘超把韩小汐往前一推，“她怎么样？”

    于清显然没想到副导演居然给他从天而降送来了一个替身。

    一抬头，认出是前两天溺水的小姑娘。

    他有印象，形象身材都没话说。

    说句不好听的，当女主都够了。

    不过，他们这一行不是有颜值就能混出来的。

    于清暗自摇了下头，“就你了，快去弄妆造，不用上妆，不拍正脸。”

    一旁田馨看到自己这么容易就被顶了，一跺脚跑去了外面自己的保姆车。

    韩小汐刚搞清情况，原来是要她来拍这段露背戏。

    不是全裸，穿肚兜拍摄。

    韩小汐倒是没多少思想包袱，毕竟上辈子阳光沙滩比基尼，她也体验过不少次。

    只是——

    “导演！先谈价格，行不？”她摆出一副人畜无害的笑容，看着于清。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She laughed to herself.

Simply take out your antique mobile phone and play Snake to kill time.

Anyway, Director Yu was busy for a while and had no time to look for her.

However, before she had played for a few minutes, there was an argument at the filming site.

"Tian Xin! What kind of plane are you doing! Are you telling me that you can't shoot now?! Are you kidding the entire crew?" Director Yu Qing, who was in his fifties, smashed the doorframe on the side with the script in his hand angrily.

Caught everyone's attention.

Han Xiaoxi also poked his head curiously.

Tian Xin, who was wearing a gauze costume and a down jacket, wiped her tears with a tissue, "Director Yu, I really can't take the photo. I've already caught a cold. No matter how hot the water is, I can't bear to take the photo over and over again."

She cried so hard, "Just use a substitute."

"Miss Tian! You said earlier that you didn't need a stunt double for today's scene. You said you would do it yourself! It's about to be filmed, and you're kidding me! Do you know how much it costs to stop for one minute?!" Yu Qing was so angry that she almost cursed.

Someone came to break up the fight, but Tian Xin had an expression like "I have a backing, and you can't replace me."

Oil and salt are not allowed to enter.

Han Xiaoxi noticed that the male protagonist Shen Heng had already gone to the rest chair to drink water and paid no attention to the two parties in the argument.

She was still wearing the long black down jacket she had seen before.

Wearing a hood and an ancient costume, the skin color on the face was deliberately darkened to make it look more angular.

Seemingly noticing someone looking at him, Shen Heng turned his head. When he saw Han Xiaoxi, he was slightly startled, and then nodded slightly to her.

Han Xiaoxi grinned hopelessly.

At this moment, Liu Chao ran towards her in a hurry.

"Xiao tide, Xiao tide! Hurry and save the situation!" He said and directly pulled her to the center of the conflict.

Han Xiaoxi was dragged away before she could react. Shen Heng saw this and put down the water glass, frowning.

"Director Yu, there is a substitute on site!" Liu Chao pushed Han Xiaoxi forward, "How is she?"

Yu Qing obviously didn’t expect that the assistant director actually sent him a stand-in from the sky.

When I looked up, I recognized the little girl who had drowned two days ago.

He has an impression, his image and figure are nothing to say.

To put it bluntly, being the heroine is enough.

“ However, their profession does not come just by looking good.

Yu Qing shook his head secretly, "It's up to you. Go get your makeup done quickly. No need to put on makeup or take a picture of your face."

On the side, Tian Xin saw that she was being pushed so easily, and ran outside to her nanny car.

Han Xiaoxi just found out the situation and it turned out that she was asked to film this backless scene.

It’s not about being completely naked, just wearing a bellyband for the photo shoot.

Han Xiaoxi doesn’t have much ideological baggage. After all, she has experienced sun and beach bikinis many times in her previous life.

It’s just——

"Director! Let's talk about the price first, okay?" She put on a harmless smile and looked at Yu Qing.
